Inspect stopped sources retained by Move, or explicitly remove one

Usage: mj move-sources [OPTIONS] --session <SESSION>

Options:
  -i, --instance <NAME>    Isolate configuration, database, daemon, and logs under `instances/<name>`. This is a different `mj` world, not a harness profile; explicit `MJ_CONFIG_DIR`/`MJ_DATA_DIR` still take precedence [env: MJ_INSTANCE=]
      --session <SESSION>  Session whose retained Move sources should be listed or cleaned up
      --cleanup <CLEANUP>  Operation ID of the retained source to delete
      --no-splash          Start the dashboard without the animated startup splash, for example over a slow remote connection [env: MJ_NO_SPLASH=]
      --yes                Confirm deletion of the retained source and its excluded files
  -h, --help               Print help
